execution_overview.overall_summary: Rebuilt and re-executed with correct low-caste sample restriction. Task1 received bounded convergence repairs (district via idxmax, centering/scaling, removal of zero-variance controls, multiple optimizers), but both mixed-effects models still failed with singular matrices, producing no usable domlow estimates. Task2 executed successfully under the low-caste restriction: domlow is positive and significant in the base model but becomes non-significant with allowed controls and full interactions. Structured results were extracted for both Task2 models.

deviations.description: Implemented low-caste sample restriction; derived district as categorical via idxmax; centered/scaled continuous predictors; dropped zero-variance controls; added MixedLM optimizer retries.
deviations.reason: To adhere to planned sample restriction and address convergence issues while keeping model structure intact.

method_fidelity.fidelity_note: Followed the planned path with permitted bounded repairs; however, models still failed to converge (singular matrices).

test_statistics.other: Both MixedLM fits failed after up to 3 optimizer attempts per model with 'Singular matrix'.

result_raw.result_text: No estimable domlow effect in Task1 due to persistent singularity in mixed-effects models after retries.

conclusion.conclusion_text: Task1 yielded no usable estimate for the domlow effect after bounded convergence repairs.

failure.failure_reason: Singular matrix in MixedLM for both Task1 models despite bounded repairs.

deviations.description: Implemented low-caste restriction and ensured structured extraction for domlow in both base and expanded models; increased max iterations.
deviations.reason: To align with sample restriction and reporting requirements.

method_fidelity.fidelity_note: Followed the planned path with allowed controls and full interactions, without prohibited controls.

test_statistics.other: Base model (Task2_Model1): domlow positive and significant.

result_raw.result_text: Base mixed-effects model (low-caste sample): domlow significantly positively associated with log(total income) (coef ≈ 0.280, p ≈ 0.042, N=943). Expanded model with allowed controls and full interactions: domlow not significant (coef ≈ -0.152, p ≈ 0.834).

conclusion.conclusion_text: Under the planned Task2 specifications with low-caste restriction, the domlow effect is sensitive to specification: significant in the base model but not with allowed controls and full interactions.
